segments.t: 十分钟后，凯勒布拿着他的真皮笔记本，和他哥哥欧文一起匆匆走下楼，欧文周五重逢后一早就从波特兰的公寓走过来了。汉娜在阳光房门口迎接他们。请先听一遍。
Hannah, Tessa told us you unlocked a hidden ninth room!
My little brother grabbed his tape measure before finishing his toast.
Step inside, both of you! Tell us if this room is safe to open.
Four meters wide, six meters long, brick wall on the left, wood ceiling above.
Hear how quiet the street sounds when you clap your hands once?
Zero echo! Wood above glass makes soft music and quiet conversation shine.
So Tessa's neighborhood cafe and Evelyn's piano will not wake the upstairs guests?
Not at all. The thick brick wall blocks every sound from the stairs.
I have the whole weekend free from City Hall, Hannah. Put us both to work!
Can you two help carry the cellar tables in after lunch?
Gladly. Working beside Caleb beats sitting at an office desk any day.
First let me sketch the window latches so fresh air flows from the courtyard.
现在我们一步步分析每一句话。
Hannah, Tessa told us you unlocked a hidden ninth room!
‘汉娜，泰莎告诉我们你用钥匙打开了一个隐藏的第九个房间！’前缀 un- 反转了 lock 的意思：
unlocked
并请注意 told 直接跟人，told us，中间不用加介词 to。
My little brother grabbed his tape measure before finishing his toast.
‘我弟弟连吐司都没吃完就抓起他的卷尺跑下来了。’在像 before 这样的介词后面，动词要加上 -ing：
before finishing his toast
请记住，toast 作为烤面包是不可数名词，从不加 s。
Step inside, both of you! Tell us if this room is safe to open.
‘你们俩快进来！告诉我们打开这个房间是否安全。’为了同时邀请两个人，非常生动的说法是加上
both of you!
并以 safe to open（安全打开）结尾。
Four meters wide, six meters long, brick wall on the left, wood ceiling above.
‘四米宽，六米长，左边是砖墙，上面是木质天花板。’英语中的尺寸表达不需要用 'of'，而是把形容词放在最后：
Four meters wide
接着是 six meters long。
Hear how quiet the street sounds when you clap your hands once?
‘你听，当你拍手时，街上的声音听起来多么安静？’与 sound、look 或 feel 等感官动词连用时，要用形容词而不是副词，而且
clap your hands once?
表示只拍一下手。
Zero echo! Wood above glass makes soft music and quiet conversation shine.
‘零回音！玻璃上的木材让柔和的音乐和安静的对话熠熠生辉。’在比喻意义上，make something shine 意思是让某事物展现出最好的一面，比如
quiet conversation shine.
shine 前面不用加 to。
So Tessa's neighborhood cafe and Evelyn's piano will not wake the upstairs guests?
‘那么泰莎的街区咖啡馆和伊芙琳的钢琴就不会吵醒楼上的客人了？’单词 upstairs 直接放在名词前面作为形容词：
the upstairs guests?
这比 'the guests who are upstairs' 要简洁得多。
Not at all. The thick brick wall blocks every sound from the stairs.
‘完全不会。厚厚的砖墙挡住了传向楼梯的所有声音。’为了完全打消别人的顾虑，没有比
Not at all.
更好的表达了，意思是根本不。
I have the whole weekend free from City Hall, Hannah. Put us both to work!
‘我整个周末都不用去市政厅上班，汉娜。给我们俩分配点活儿吧！’当有人热情地自告奋勇时，他们会说
Put us both to work!
结合 put someone to work 的表达。
Can you two help carry the cellar tables in after lunch?
‘午饭后你们俩能帮忙把地下室的桌子搬进来吗？’因为 you 在单复数同形，所以在对话中为了澄清，经常加上
Can you two
接着是 help carry。
Gladly. Working beside Caleb beats sitting at an office desk any day.
‘非常乐意。无论哪一天，和凯勒布并肩工作都比坐在办公桌前强多了。’这里的动词 beat 意思是‘胜过，比……好得多’，最后加上
any day.
毫不犹豫的意思。
First let me sketch the window latches so fresh air flows from the courtyard.
‘首先让我画一个窗户插销的草图，这样从庭院吹来的新鲜空气就能流进来。’凯勒布在两个完整的句子之间用 so 表示‘为了，以便’，而 flows 描述了空气平缓的流动。让我们以正常语速再听一遍整个场景。
Hannah, Tessa told us you unlocked a hidden ninth room!
My little brother grabbed his tape measure before finishing his toast.
Step inside, both of you! Tell us if this room is safe to open.
Four meters wide, six meters long, brick wall on the left, wood ceiling above.
Hear how quiet the street sounds when you clap your hands once?
Zero echo! Wood above glass makes soft music and quiet conversation shine.
So Tessa's neighborhood cafe and Evelyn's piano will not wake the upstairs guests?
Not at all. The thick brick wall blocks every sound from the stairs.
I have the whole weekend free from City Hall, Hannah. Put us both to work!
Can you two help carry the cellar tables in after lunch?
Gladly. Working beside Caleb beats sitting at an office desk any day.
First let me sketch the window latches so fresh air flows from the courtyard.
凯勒布完全认可这个房间的声学效果，而欧文则愿意在周末提供一双强壮的臂膀帮忙。下个场景见。
Take care!
